title: Project with Interact club- UDAAN
summary: The UDAAN – Interactor’s District conference was held at Dinanath Mangeshker Hall, Vile parle East. There were 14 schools that had participated.
description:
The UDAAN – Interactor’s District conference was held at Dinanath Mangeshker Hall, Vile parle East. There were 14 schools that had participated. Our interact Club from Bangur nagar Vidya Mandir participated in the Event. There were overall 25 students from our interact club who participated in various activities like Dance, Drawing competition.

Our interact Club won the Third prize in the Drawing Competition.

Ms. Sofia from Brazil our RYE Student also attended the event.
location: Dinanath Mangeshkar Hall Vile parle, Mumbai, Maharashtra
